where.if: AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.receiver LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, receiver, phone, address_detail, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{receiver}, #{phone}, #{addressDetail}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.username AS user_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT o.*, u.username AS user_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT o.*, u.username AS user_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, u.username AS user_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 1, pay_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 0
UPDATE orders SET status = 2, send_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1
UPDATE orders SET status = 3, finish_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 2
UPDATE orders SET status = 4 WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 0
UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
